name: StockBreaker
source:
The Dragon of Wall Street is born!

Manage your portfolio and your personal life in this stock market visual novel!  Profit from a wild American economy, with historic real life stock events: presidential elections, auto-industry bailouts, Wall Street protests, quantitative easing and so much more!

Five different endings, six crazy personalities, dozens of choices to make and a ton of comedy in-between!  One million in 100 days. But it's not just about the money, right heartbreaker?

You up for the challenge, stockbreaker?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.stockbreaker.activity&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
